At p=0 the k positive units leave q=m+1 slots, consisting of the m residual coefficients and the vanishing coordinate; at p=1 the k+1 positive units leave q=m residual slots with total k. Balance and m≥k give admissible endpoints. The same fixed-q equalization bounds them by B_{d,k} and B_{d,k+1}, respectively.

The integer gamma survival and the Laplace transform of the independent negative sum give factor (1/2)(q/(q+k−1))^q. The tilt gives mean 1/2 for the fixed phase and mean (k−1)/(q+k−1) for each residual phase; at k=1 the residual terms are identically zero. The coefficient of each moment divided by its factorial has the stated binomial multiplicity.
